args:
mkdir -p /workspace/src
echo "hello from the sandbox" > /workspace/hello.txt
printf '{\n  "name": "sandbox-workspace"\n}\n' > /workspace/package.json
echo "console.log('hi');" > /workspace/src/index.
cat > /workspace/add.js << 'EOF'
const [a, b] = [Number(process.argv[2]), Number(process.argv[3])];
setTimeout(() => { console.log(a + b); }, 5000);
EOF
cat > /workspace/subtract.js << 'EOF'
const [a, b] = [Number(process.argv[2]), Number(process.argv[3])];
setTimeout(() => { console.log(a - b); }, 14000);
EOF
touch /workspace/.ready
exec tail -f /dev/null
containers.name: runner
